title: Reaching terminal velocity
caption: Drag grows with speed until it balances weight minus upthrust. For the steel ball in glycerol, v_t = 2r²(ρ_s − ρ_f)g / 9η = 10.2 mm s⁻¹, reached within a few milliseconds (time constant 1.24 ms).
alt: Speed against time rising steeply then levelling off at the terminal velocity of about 10 millimetres per second.
description: r = 1.0 mm, ρ_s = 7800 kg m⁻³, ρ_f = 1260 kg m⁻³, η = 1.4 Pa s.
With linear drag the approach is exponential, time constant v_t ρ_s / ((ρ_s − ρ_f) g) = 1.24 ms.
Measuring v_t is how a falling-ball viscometer finds η.

checks.name: the speed levels off at the terminal velocity
